source_eligibility: source-informed incident-mechanism adaptation; exposed qualification; not field deployment or blind bug discovery
incident_query: which delivered requests after a deployment used a mismatched resident dependency?
audit_horizon: immediate before flush and after workload drain or process recovery
assumptions: trusted owned Python host, immutable owned artifact/code files and faithful instrumented callable binding
one serialized MLflow predict call per client request; no hidden retries, callers or subprocess computation
parent census and reference journaling are common control instrumentation, not free native observability
compact/full share event stream, SQLite WAL/FULL, acknowledgement frontier and query
eviction repair is owned-module serial policy, not concurrent import isolation
process kill is not OS/power loss or hostile-host completeness
incident demand is externally motivated; finite deployment-to-detection window is authored, not observed field timing

predictions.same_name_shared_process: later different artifact can use first resident implementation
predictions.synchronized_owned_eviction: repairs subsequent loads in this serial service
predictions.fresh_B_first: B implementation used until another same-name implementation requested
predictions.delayed_delivery: unknown before drain; recoverable after actual flush
predictions.acknowledged_FULL_prefix: all acknowledged payloads recover after killing DB-owning child

retention_premise: ordinary compact retention with interval pins/drain first; no algorithm admission from this small unpressured workload
